## Purpose

Prove that a durable artifact URI still names the bytes it claims. Resolves an
`artifact://sha256/<digest>` URI inside AQ's own content-addressed store and
re-hashes the object behind it, so a receipt cannot outlive its evidence
silently. Read-only, and scoped to this store: `s3://` and `https://` receipts
are the external artifact adapter's to serve and are refused here rather than
guessed at.

Use it to re-check evidence at review or promotion time, or to confirm retention
before a receipt quotes a URI.

The command delegates to `ObjectLoopCommandsMixin` in
[`src/commands/object_loop_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/object_loop_commands.py)
over the store in [`src/object_loop/artifacts.py`](../../../src/object_loop/artifacts.py).
Verification writes nothing and survives restarts unchanged.
